abstract.p: SemEval Task 7 introduced a dataset for multilingual and cross lingual fact checking. We propose a system that leverages similarity matching, KNN, zero-shot classification and summarization to retrieve fact-checks for social media posts across multiple languages. Our approach achieves performance within the expected range, aligning with baseline results. Although competitive, the findings highlight the potential and challenges of zero-shot methods, providing a foundation for future research in cross lingual information verification.
